Spark plan overview

Analytics on the free Spark plan

The game is published. Basic Google Analytics and the existing total visit counter remain available. Game starts, deliveries, landings, and results are sent to Google Analytics when its SDK is available.

Open Google Analytics · View the existing visit counter in Firebase · Play Orbital Freight

The custom session timeline and click heatmap are inactive because their Cloud Functions backend requires Blaze. Run history remains saved in the game on each player's browser. Previous local runs are not uploaded.

Custom session collection and click heatmap are inactive on Spark.
